Henry Ware Jr.: hymns in Tonic Solfa

Henry Ware Jr. (1794–1843) · Hymn writer

5 hymns on NoteFusion credit Henry Ware Jr.. Each is written out in Tonic Solfa under the words, with staff notation, a piano to sing along with and a free PDF to print.

Words

  • All Nature's Works His Praise Declare

    All nature's works his praise declare

    Doh is Bb4/4Tune: ALL SAINTS, NEWSolfa PDF

  • Father in Heaven, to Thee My Heart

    Father in heaven, to thee my heart

    Doh is F4/4Tune: YORKSolfa PDF

  • Father in Heaven, to Whom Our Hearts

    Father in heaven, to whom our hearts

    Doh is F4/4Tune: ST. FLAVIANSolfa PDF

  • Like Israel's Hosts to Exile Driven

    Like Israel's hosts to exile driven,

    Doh is C4/4Tune: MELITASolfa PDF

  • O Thou, Who on Thy Chosen Son

    O Thou, who on thy chosen Son

    Doh is G4/4Tune: OLD HUNDREDTHSolfa PDF
